external_collaboration.evidence_quote: In Ireland, we work closely with a network of clinical partner sites, including Connolly Hospital, Beaumont Hospital, St James’s Hospital, the Rotunda Hospital, Mater Misericordiae University Hospital, Our Lady of Lourdes Hospital Drogheda, Cavan General Hospital and Bon Secours Hospital. These partnerships provide valuable clinical insights and opportunities to translate research into practice.
